player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} mukati mezu ya {num_rounds} ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Muzu wese, taura nambari iri pakati pa {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Mambo mawiri ataura, chipo chakatarisirwa ndicho (2/3)x(wastani wechokwadiwa na vaviri),
na mchezaji ane chokwadiwa pedyo ne chipo ndiye anohwina muzu uyu.
Dhindura ne chokwadiwa chako mufananidzo wa '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomati isiriyo; tapota tumira fungidziro yako se [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Fungidzira kunofanira kuva pakati pe {min_guess} ne {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mwari 0 akatenga {guess0}; Mwari 1 akatenga {guess1}. Kwa hivyo Lengo ni: {target}.
